drafts: Knowledge flows like poison through its veins, each truth more toxic than silence.
It gorges on wisdom until even enlightenment becomes agony.
The more it learns, the more it suffers—and it can never stop learning.
data.chosen: Draft 3 - This captures both the compulsive nature of the mandatory draw and the life loss consequence. The phrase 'can never stop learning' directly evokes the twisted compulsion that makes this sphinx dangerous, while 'suffers' ties to the life loss. It ends strongly on 'learning' which subverts the typical positive association with knowledge.
data.content: The more it learns, the more it suffers—and it can never stop learning.

Write flavor text for a fake Magic: The Gathering card — a twisted
version of a real card.

Fake name: Desecrated Sphinx

Type: Creature — Sphinx

The flavor text should:

- Be 1-2 sentences, max 140 characters

- Not repeat or explain the rules text
- End on a strong word
